goal: Expose the official Feishu Messenger web client as the primary message surface in the company desktop app with a durable employee login and truthful fallback boundaries.

included: official Feishu Messenger conversation list and chat surface embedded in the PySide6 desktop shell
Feishu global navigation and web-only notification banner removed from the focused message surface
a branded macOS application identity using the 巅池桌面助手 name and the existing company logo while retaining the legacy login data directory
persistent Feishu cookies, local storage, and web permissions
popup, download, media permission, and external-browser handling
a separately named company assistant message center backed by DC-Agent APIs
an explicit user-agent override for diagnostics
excluded: copying or reverse engineering Feishu native desktop code
claiming that bot-scoped Open Platform APIs expose an employee's complete personal inbox
silently granting camera or microphone access to non-Feishu origins

acceptance_criteria.description: The desktop navigation opens official Feishu Messenger from the primary 消息 item and labels the DC-Agent-backed conversation view as 小助手.

Feishu uses a dedicated persistent QWebEngine profile and a version-matched Chrome user agent derived from the embedded Chromium engine by default; a custom user agent is used only when explicitly configured.
Login popups no longer replace the Messenger page, downloads require an explicit destination, and camera or microphone requests are presented to the employee only for Feishu origins.
A no-GUI regression suite verifies desktop wiring without launching the desktop pet or mutating a real Feishu conversation.

The embedded surface starts at the Messenger conversation list, preserves a polished 25/75 list-to-chat layout with neutral gray separators, and does not expose Feishu's global app navigation or notification banner.

The macOS Dock and application window identify the product as 巅池桌面助手 with the existing company logo, a company-owned bundle identifier and branded in-bundle executable rather than org.python.python, without changing the persistent Feishu storage directory.
